Existing code wrappers have ordinaryRTS/task contracts; eightbytes bounded by indirectJMPFF08 and NMI routineFF13, independent valid task mask/phase selection. Effective lower PRG irrelevant for fixedbank15 pointers.

editorial_audit.notes: Targeted final acceptance reused sound 6724-region/412-unit readability credit. Confirmed eleven scope corrections and 35 immediate-alias removals; corrected residual callable/no-op wording, propagated stale nested summaries, refreshed all current unit links, replaced six generic unit summaries with existing mechanical source explanations and corrected obsolete camera-BRK inventory wording. No classification/natural reachability claim added. See editorial-audit.md; three unknown bytes remain. Normalized 1649 data-unit name references to reviewed objects; canonical ranges now accompany every nested unit. Correcting the legacy camera alias exposed one duplicate identical physical unit: 412 retained records reduce to 411 distinct current canonical units; history preserved.

commentary_units.name: UpdateSoundEngine
commentary_units.summary: Consume the shifted sound request, then tick music voices 0..3 and effect voices 4..6. Zero means continue current streams; the high-bit request selects the effect group. Selection IDs and the exact request encoding remain uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: StartMusicSelection
commentary_units.summary: Reload music pattern bases/offset tables for the selected ID and initialize its four voices. Preserve effect-owned APU channels while changing music.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: StartEffectSelection
commentary_units.summary: Clear the previous effect channel claims, load the new effect tables and initialize three effect voices. The selected streams determine which hardware channels are claimed.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ClearSoundRequest
commentary_units.summary: A request is consumed once; ordinary later ticks retain the saved voice state.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: TickMusicVoices
commentary_units.summary: Tick active music slots in descending order. Unpack each saved cursor pair, process its duration/stream, and save the updated cursors.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: TickEffectVoices
commentary_units.summary: Apply the same stream interpreter to effect slots 6..4; their channel mask gives them priority over music writes.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InitializeMusicVoices
commentary_units.summary: Initialize four music sequence pointers from the selection table, then retain their interpreter state.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InitializeEffectVoices
commentary_units.summary: Initialize three effect sequence pointers; the shared initializer rebases their slot indices to 0..2.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SaveSoundVoiceCursors
commentary_units.summary: Persist sequence/pattern pointers and their independent byte cursors for voice X.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: LoadSoundVoiceCursors
commentary_units.summary: Restore the working sequence/pattern pointers and cursors for voice X.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ResolveMusicSequence
commentary_units.summary: Use twice the voice index plus the music selection as a pointer-table offset. This code assumes the corresponding bank-0 tables remain mapped.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ResolveEffectSequence
commentary_units.summary: Rebase effect slot X by four, then use the effect selection to choose its sequence pointer.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InitializeSoundSequence
commentary_units.summary: Read the selected sequence pointer, clear duration/hold/repeat state, mark the channel unassigned and activate the voice.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InterpretSoundSequence
commentary_units.summary: Sequence byte 1 selects a pattern through a relative-offset table; byte 2 replaces the sequence cursor; byte 3 reads or decrements the repeat counter and restores the saved cursor until its final iteration. Other command values stop the voice. The bounded sequence/pattern graph is classified; natural selection of every root is unproved.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: StopSoundVoice
commentary_units.summary: Deactivate this voice and silence its hardware channel, subject to effect priority.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: JumpSoundSequenceCursor
commentary_units.summary: The next sequence byte is an absolute byte offset within the same sequence, rather than a ROM pointer.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SelectSoundPattern
commentary_units.summary: Resolve a pattern index through the music/effect offset table and add that group's pattern base. Reset the pattern cursor and continue decoding events.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: RepeatSoundSequence
commentary_units.summary: Test the per-voice repeat count. Zero reads and saves a repeat offset/count; one decrements then skips the repeat operands. Larger counts decrement and restore the saved cursor before dispatching again.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SelectSoundInstrument
commentary_units.summary: A negative pattern byte selects an eight-byte instrument record at CPU $8000. Its first fields supply pitch bias and hardware channel; later output paths consume control/timer flags.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: TickSoundVoice
commentary_units.summary: While a duration remains, only handle note release and decrement it. Otherwise decode the next pattern event; $FF returns to the outer sequence interpreter.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ReadSoundPatternEvent
commentary_units.summary: Nonnegative events pack note index in the low nibble and pitch shift in the high nibble. The following byte indexes a duration table and carries hold bit $40. Negative events change instrument; $FF returns to sequence commands.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ComputeSoundTimer
commentary_units.summary: Look up a 16-bit note timer, right-shift by the adjusted pitch field when positive, then send it to the selected APU channel. Zero/negative shifts leave the table value intact.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SaveSoundHoldFlag
commentary_units.summary: The duration byte also supplies a hold flag; retain it so the next tick decides whether to release the note.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AdvanceSoundDuration
commentary_units.summary: On the final tick, release unless the hold flag is set; then decrement the remaining duration.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SilenceSoundChannel
commentary_units.summary: Skip unassigned channels. Music may not silence a channel claimed by an effect; effects update their claim mask before clearing the APU enable bit.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WriteSoundChannel
commentary_units.summary: Effects claim their hardware channel; music writes are suppressed while an effect owns it. Enable the channel, then dispatch channel IDs 0/1/2/other to pulse1/pulse2/triangle/noise registers.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WritePulse1Registers
commentary_units.summary: Merge adjusted volume with instrument control, write sweep, and combine the computed timer with instrument length flags.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WritePulse2Registers
commentary_units.summary: Write the second pulse channel using the same instrument/timer layout as pulse1.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WriteTriangleRegisters
commentary_units.summary: Adjust the triangle control byte, then write the timer and instrument length flags.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WriteNoiseRegisters
commentary_units.summary: Use the timer low nibble as the noise period, combined with instrument mode flags. No tonal high-timer write is needed.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AdjustPulseNoiseVolume
commentary_units.summary: Add the signed global volume adjustment to the low control nibble and clamp to 0..15. Preserve the original upper control bits.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AdjustTriangleControl
commentary_units.summary: Adjust the triangle control byte by pairs of volume steps: positive adjustment rotates in set bits; negative adjustment shifts right. Preserve the caller's voice index X. Exact loudness correspondence is uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 0 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InitializeScoreRecords
commentary_units.summary: Copy $84 bytes from the bank-local template to RAM $0400..$0483. Later code treats these as ten twelve-byte score/name records.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitForVblank
commentary_units.summary: Busy-wait on PPUSTATUS bit 7, then read it again to clear the latch. This polls the PPU rather than the frame interrupt flag.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: EnableUnscrolledDisplay
commentary_units.summary: Wait for vblank, clear scroll and PPUCTRL, then enable background/sprite rendering with PPUMASK $1E. Keep software register shadows synchronized.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DisableDisplayAndHideSprites
commentary_units.summary: Clear PPU control/mask at vblank, then fill and DMA the sprite page. This prepares a screen change without visible sprite remnants.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ShowScoreRecords
commentary_units.summary: Preserve the six-byte current score on the stack, change screen resources, draw ten score/name records and insert the current score. Accepted keyboard entry and wait/timeout paths complete the presentation before restoring the saved score.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: UploadScorePalette
commentary_units.summary: Copy 32 palette bytes to PPU $3F00 before drawing the score table.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: PaintScoreAttributes
commentary_units.summary: Populate the score screen attribute cells with $55/$AA patterns. PPUDATA reads deliberately advance the VRAM address between the selected cells.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawScoreRecordRows
commentary_units.summary: Each twelve-byte RAM record has six glyph bytes and six decimal digits. Render a row, advance the PPU destination by 32 tiles, and stop after ten records.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawScoreDigits
commentary_units.summary: Track whether any prior digit was nonzero; replace leading zeroes with tile $1E, while always drawing the final digit. Digit tiles begin at $1F.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: CheckScoreInsertionResult
commentary_units.summary: Y=$78 denotes no insertion. That path enables the score display and skips keyboard name entry.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitOnScoreScreen
commentary_units.summary: Poll input for up to 100 vblanks, exiting early on either mask-$30 button. Restore the saved score and finish clearing the record state before returning.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ClearScoreNametable
commentary_units.summary: Fill thirty rows of 32 tiles with blank tile $1E, then clear 64 attribute bytes. Leaves the PPU write address immediately after this nametable.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: RenderEncodedText
commentary_units.summary: Use RAM $54/$55 as the string pointer and $56/$57 as the PPU destination. Nonnegative bytes pass through the glyph mapper. $FF ends; other negative bytes advance the destination by their low seven bits. Strings therefore encode both text and skips.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: HandleTextSkipOrEnd
commentary_units.summary: Stop at $FF; otherwise update the saved 16-bit destination, rewrite PPUADDR and resume at the next encoded byte. The arithmetic preserves the carry convention from the terminator comparison.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: HideAllSprites
commentary_units.summary: Fill CPU page $03 with $FF and transfer it to OAM using OAMDMA page 3. The same RAM page is the software sprite buffer.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: InsertCurrentScore
commentary_units.summary: Compare the six score bytes lexicographically with existing records, searching from the final record. Equal bytes continue the comparison; insertion shifts lower records and stores the current score. Name entry is handled separately.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: CompareScoreBytes
commentary_units.summary: Compare record score bytes at $03FA+Y with current score $1B+X from most significant to least significant. Equality continues through all six bytes.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: StoreInsertedScore
commentary_units.summary: Copy the current six-byte score to the selected record and return the insertion offset in Y.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: TestObjectHorizontalWindow
commentary_units.summary: Get an object coordinate through $C4B3, subtract the 16-bit reference at $19/$1A, and return carry set outside approximately -32..1056 units. The low-byte edge tests preserve the boundary distinction; coordinate units are not yet established.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: NudgeObjectTowardReference
commentary_units.summary: Repeat three coordinate corrections toward the 16-bit world reference plus $0200. Clear the low two X bits before adding or subtracting four units; propagate carry or borrow into the high byte and preserve Y across the helper.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 12 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: RunDemonstrationScene
commentary_units.summary: Load screen selector 5, initialize scene state and two objects at reference-relative positions, then run object/frame updates in three-frame intervals. Exit on mask-$30 input and wait for the pending update cursors to agree. This resembles a demonstration; exact scene purpose remains tentative.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DemonstrationFrameLoop
commentary_units.summary: Request a frame, poll controls, update objects and sprites, then wait for the frame latch to clear. A three-tick interval separates input exit checks.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: PrepareMenuScreen
commentary_units.summary: Disable display, load resource $0D, select resource 6, clear the nametable and hide sprites before drawing menu content.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: EnableMenuDisplay
commentary_units.summary: Wait for vblank, reset scroll, and enable the unscrolled background/sprite display while synchronizing software PPU shadows.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ServiceSoundEveryFourCalls
commentary_units.summary: Advance a modulo-four divider at $9F. Invoke the sound service on nonzero divider values; skip every fourth call. This helper is called while screens wait for input.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: RunModeMenu
commentary_units.summary: Draw conditional menu strings according to $B9 and menu state $06C0. Construct selectable row bounds, run the cursor loop, then update choice state $65 and $06C0. Exact mode labels should be taken from the adjacent encoded strings, not inferred solely from the selectors.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SetMenuInitialRow
commentary_units.summary: Store the initial row index and conditionally draw an additional string before enabling the display.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: CommitModeMenuChoice
commentary_units.summary: Compare selected row with the final row; a conditional auxiliary menu may run. For the initial states store choice+1 at $65 and reset $BA/$BB; later states increment $06C0.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ChooseMenuRow
commentary_units.summary: Inputs A=row maximum (bit7 enables left/right choice), X=cursor x coordinate, Y=row-table bias. Wait for confirm release, poll five vblanks per iteration, clamp up/down selection and return on masks $D0. Selection is returned through RAM $2B; optional horizontal choice through $30.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitForMenuConfirmRelease
commentary_units.summary: Keep servicing sound and polling input until mask $90 clears, preventing a held confirm from immediately selecting the next menu.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: MenuInputDelay
commentary_units.summary: Redraw the cursor and service input/sound for five vblanks between selection changes.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ApplyMenuDirectionalInput
commentary_units.summary: Up/down decrement/increment row $2B within 0..$2C. Optional left/right chooses one of two cursor x positions and stores its side in $30.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: TestMenuConfirmation
commentary_units.summary: Any held bit in mask $D0 exits; other input repeats the timed cursor loop.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawMenuCursor
commentary_units.summary: Write the first OAM record using tile $52, attributes 0, the configured x coordinate and a table-selected y coordinate. DMA page 3 to OAM.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ShowSelectedScreen
commentary_units.summary: A is a screen selector. Multiply by three to index resource triples at $DED6, stop prior sound, load the selector sound and graphics/palette resources, then dispatch special presentation paths. Selector 3 is used by the artificial ending experiment; natural completion is separate evidence.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DispatchScreenPresentation
commentary_units.summary: Selectors 5/6 draw stage-related text before the common return. Other selectors may run animation helpers or a timed/input wait. The encoded-text helper at A56D handles row advance, termination and glyph remapping.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: EnableSelectedScreen
commentary_units.summary: Reset PPU scroll and enable mask $0E. Selector 4 waits 180 vblanks; selector 0 waits for START while servicing sound.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitForTitleStart
commentary_units.summary: Wait for mask $10 (START), servicing vblank and sound throughout. Stop sound when accepted.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitForTimedScreen
commentary_units.summary: Use a two-byte countdown initialized to $0300. Poll input each iteration and permit early exit on mask $30. Selector 3 additionally advances the ending screen animation.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: WaitForScreenInputRelease
commentary_units.summary: Require all controller bits to clear before stopping sound and returning, preventing input spillover into the next screen.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AnimateEndingScreen
commentary_units.summary: Every ten calls toggle a two-state index and load the corresponding resource from $AB30. Reset PPUADDR after the transfer. This is the palette/resource alternation reached by ending selector 3.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AdvancePseudoRandomState
commentary_units.summary: Nine rounds of shifts/XOR feedback update the three-byte state at $A3..$A5; return the final low state byte in A and preserve Y. The polynomial/period has not been established.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AppendConditionalSprite
commentary_units.summary: When RAM PauseState is nonzero, search OAM backwards for a hidden sprite and begin copying a tile from $AC19. The construction fills six sprite slots at ten-pixel horizontal spacing; the exact decorative purpose remains unresolved.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawEightStatusSprites
commentary_units.summary: A supplies a marker index. Find available OAM entries, choose tile $22/$24/$26 from the relative index and RAM $07 threshold, then place eight sprites twelve pixels apart starting at x=$58. Exact gameplay meaning of the markers is uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: ChooseStatusMarkerTile
commentary_units.summary: Compare marker ordinal X with the supplied index; at equality RAM $07 below/above $1E distinguishes the tile. Tile choice also contributes carry to the y coordinate.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawStageTextAndDigits
commentary_units.summary: Render stage-indexed text and an eight-byte, two-row digit tile record. Depending on mode $65, also draw another selected string, then draw stage text selector stage+$11.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawStageDigitTiles
commentary_units.summary: Use twice the zero-based stage at $22 to select an eight-byte record through $B359. Add tile base $53 and emit four tiles on each of two consecutive PPU rows.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DrawStageNameText
commentary_units.summary: Select string stage+$11 and render it at PPU $2060. The preceding path may draw an extra mode-dependent caption.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: RenderScreenTextByIndex
commentary_units.summary: A indexes little-endian string pointers at $B319. Destination $2E/$2D is high/low. Byte 1 terminates; byte 0 moves to the next row; negative bytes skip PPUDATA cells; other bytes map through the glyph alphabet.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: AdvanceScreenTextRow
commentary_units.summary: Add 32 to the saved row address and rewrite PPUADDR before processing the next byte.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: SkipScreenTextCells
commentary_units.summary: Low seven bits give the number of PPUDATA reads used to advance the VRAM cursor. This adjusts the live PPU address without changing the saved row origin.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: MapTextGlyphToTile
commentary_units.summary: Search the alphabet at $AD41 for the encoded character and return its index+$1E, preserving X. The loop has no explicit length guard; supported strings must contain a character present in the alphabet.
commentary_units.context_note: Effective PRG bank 13 in its CPU slot; baseline views retained

commentary_units.name: DeactivateAllObjects
commentary_units.summary: Mark all four object slots unused with type $FF.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdateObjects
commentary_units.summary: Check player-relative conditions, update active object scripts and movement, apply pending actions, then service object timers. Slot 0 is the player; slots 1..3 are other entities. Rendering is handled separately.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdateActiveObjectScripts
commentary_units.summary: Walk slots 3..0, skipping unused objects. Unready objects follow scrolling motion; ready ones execute their script and integrate movement.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ExecuteObjectScript
commentary_units.summary: Save current slot and load its script pointer. Ordinary records set frame, optional horizontal motion, vertical delta and duration. Command bytes $61 and above dispatch through $CE05. The preliminary native-predicate path can install the configured failure script and reset frame/stack state.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DecodeObjectScriptRecord
commentary_units.summary: Mask the high bit from the first byte to select a frame or command. A set high bit on an ordinary frame adds a horizontal-motion byte. The next byte packs signed vertical motion and a three-bit duration.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdvanceObjectFrameDuration
commentary_units.summary: Store vertical motion; count this frame until the packed duration matches, then advance the script pointer by the record length and reset the frame counter to $FF.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdvanceObjectScriptPointer
commentary_units.summary: Y is the consumed byte count. Add it to the saved script pointer and immediately resume the interpreter.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ApplyPendingObjectAction
commentary_units.summary: After an optional state-specific check, a negative pending-action byte selects an action pointer through $E709. Reset interpreter counters, clear movement, and reset the per-object script stack.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TickObjectActionTimer
commentary_units.summary: Skip disabled ($FF) timers or ObjectTimerInhibit. At expiry, index a type-specific 32-byte response record, select its action pointer, and save both bytes in ObjectFallbackScriptLo/Hi.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CheckNearbyObjects
commentary_units.summary: Unless player frame is 7, examine slots 3..1. Objects within six scaled horizontal units receive response selector $31.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InterpretStageStream
commentary_units.summary: StageStreamLo/StageStreamHi points into one of fifteen bounded stage streams. Nonnegative bytes are position thresholds compared with half the stage progress byte; consume passed thresholds. Negative bytes dispatch through StageCommandPointersCPU.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DispatchStageStreamCommand
commentary_units.summary: Double the negative command byte to choose a handler pointer and jump indirectly. The fifteen bounded stage streams establish the accepted command records; their handlers implement spawn, wait, scroll, sound and completion mechanics.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdvanceStageStream
commentary_units.summary: Advance the stage stream pointer by Y and return Y=0.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: SpawnStageObject
commentary_units.summary: Normal entry clears the retry flag; alternate entry $C2AE sets it. If loading is active, return. Otherwise find a free slot among 2..3, initialize a type from the next command byte and place it relative to the scrolling reference. Slot availability and command state determine whether spawning proceeds.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeSpawnedStageObject
commentary_units.summary: Low six type bits select the object template; upper bits choose spawn side/optional randomization. A second byte provides a high-nibble parameter and low-nibble health/status count. Initialize graphics loading and advance the stream.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ConditionalStageStreamJump
commentary_units.summary: Compare half-progress with the next threshold. Before that threshold, replace the stage stream pointer with the following little-endian address; otherwise consume three bytes and resume.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: IntegrateObjectMotion
commentary_units.summary: For active objects apply horizontal motion relative to orientation, optionally constrain position, then add the signed vertical delta to the vertical coordinate.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: PushObjectScriptByte
commentary_units.summary: Use the object-specific stack pointer in $0649+X. The low nibble limits each stack to fifteen bytes; overflow returns carry and clears the PPU mask shadow. Preserve Y.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: PopObjectScriptByte
commentary_units.summary: Pop from the object-specific sixteen-byte stack partition. Carry set indicates an empty stack; preserve Y.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ResetObjectScriptStack
commentary_units.summary: Set stack pointer to X*16, the beginning of this object's partition.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: JumpObjectScript
commentary_units.summary: Read a little-endian script target at the current cursor and restart the interpreter at it.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ReturnFromObjectScript
commentary_units.summary: Pop loop counter and return pointer. On an empty stack, nonplayer objects resume their fallback script; the player chooses an action from current controls. Pause-like state $05 forces a fixed player script.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ChoosePlayerAction
commentary_units.summary: Ignore START/SELECT bits; button combinations use a stage-dependent action selector. Direction inputs pass through an orientation-dependent mapping before the action pointer table at $E7A5.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: RestartObjectScript
commentary_units.summary: Reset duration/loop counters to $FF and execute the chosen script immediately.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: GetObjectAdjustedX
commentary_units.summary: Get a frame-dependent horizontal extent, double it, and add/subtract it from the 16-bit object position according to orientation. Return low byte in Y and high byte in A.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: GetObjectFrameExtent
commentary_units.summary: The object bounds descriptor points to a per-frame table. Return the current frame's first horizontal extent; other descriptor fields are loaded by collision helpers.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ConstrainObjectWideWindow
commentary_units.summary: Use adjusted X relative to the reference to move the object toward the supported wider horizontal window. Both correction branches propagate low-byte carry or borrow into the stored high coordinate.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ConstrainPlayerPosition
commentary_units.summary: Only type zero uses these player window limits; special $AE state selects the wider-window helper. Compare adjusted position to reference-relative limits and correct low-byte position. Exact edge units remain uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptSetOrientation
commentary_units.summary: Preserve the script cursor while comparing this object and its linked target. Operand modes choose literal, inverted, player-relative or target-relative orientation. If facing changes, shift the stored position by four frame extents to keep its visible anchor aligned.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: FaceLinkedObject
commentary_units.summary: Compare the two adjusted 16-bit coordinates and choose upper orientation bits $00 or $C0.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CommitObjectOrientation
commentary_units.summary: Replace only upper orientation bits. If bit7 changes, compensate the stored x coordinate using the current frame width.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptSetObjectStateBits
commentary_units.summary: Replace low object-state bits with the operand, preserve upper bits and advance the script.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptMoveHorizontally
commentary_units.summary: Apply the next horizontal-motion byte through the facing-aware movement helper, then continue.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptRepeatBranch
commentary_units.summary: Increment the per-object loop counter; at the operand count, reset it and skip the following target. Otherwise jump to that target.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptCheckHeldControls
commentary_units.summary: Compare controls with the previously saved mask, excluding START/SELECT. A changed value selects a new action; an unchanged value continues the script.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptCallSubsequence
commentary_units.summary: Push the return pointer after the two-byte target and the current loop counter, then jump to the target. The object stack is independent of the CPU stack.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptInvokeNativeHelper
commentary_units.summary: Read a native helper pointer, call it with X/Y preserved, then advance past the operands.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CallScriptNativePointer
commentary_units.summary: Read two pointer bytes into $2C/$2D and invoke them indirectly while saving the object slot and script cursor on the CPU stack.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: JumpNativePointer
commentary_units.summary: Indirect trampoline used by the script helper call; the target returns to the caller of this trampoline.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptFindCollisionResponse
commentary_units.summary: Compute source attack bounds, scan other active slots and compare horizontal/vertical extents. A matching target may accept an action response; then link source and target and advance the script. This is a mechanical collision/response interpretation; exact move names remain unknown.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TestCandidateCollision
commentary_units.summary: Reject candidates whose state priority is too high, whose horizontal intervals do not overlap, or whose vertical range misses. An operand low nibble $F bypasses response selection.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LinkCollisionParticipants
commentary_units.summary: Save source script pointers in both participants, encode the source slot in target flags and install the operand response. A type-2 target also increments a capped global count.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ComputeAttackHorizontalBounds
commentary_units.summary: Load frame-indexed collision tables, scale x down by four, and orient the attack interval about that coordinate. Compute a vertical reference from the current object and a frame offset.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadObjectBoundsTables
commentary_units.summary: Read eight little-endian pointers from the object bounds descriptor at $0629/$062D+X into $3A..$49. Y becomes the current frame index; consumers choose the relevant extents.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ComputeTargetHorizontalBounds
commentary_units.summary: Scale the target x down by four and use its frame-indexed left/right offsets, reversing offsets for mirrored orientation. Return the interval in $30..$33.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: GetObjectScreenX
commentary_units.summary: Subtract the scrolling reference from object x and divide by four. Return $FF in A when left of the reference; otherwise A/$2A is the scaled position.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptBranchOnPlayerRange
commentary_units.summary: Require nonzero player health/count, an on-screen x window and a player-relative distance interval. If all pass, jump to the script target; otherwise skip its four operand bytes.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptBranchOnDistance
commentary_units.summary: Get unsigned player-relative distance. Jump to the script target when its high byte is zero and its low byte is below the operand threshold; otherwise continue.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: GetDistanceToPlayer
commentary_units.summary: Get both adjusted x coordinates, take the absolute 16-bit difference, divide by four and return high/low in $2A/$2B. Restore current slot from $0C.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptReduceObjectHealth
commentary_units.summary: Unless special state $AE is active, subtract operand from the object health/count and clamp at zero. Player changes also increment the HUD dirty byte.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptSpawnRelatedObject
commentary_units.summary: Find a free slot, copy position/graphics linkage from the source, initialize it using operand template/movement values, then resume the source script. Update graphics-reference counts for the copied linkage.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdjustSpawnedObjectAnchor
commentary_units.summary: If the copied object is mirrored, use frame extents to adjust its inherited position before applying its new template. The two successive corrections use the then-current frame metadata.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ConfigureSpawnedObject
commentary_units.summary: Read template ID, horizontal motion and vertical motion from script operands; refresh shared-graphics accounting for types that do not retain the inherited graphics slot.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeObjectFromTemplate
commentary_units.summary: A selects an eight-byte template at $EC42: type, health/count, timer, frame, graphics selector and fallback script. Mark type pending with bit7, load bounds/render descriptors, reset script/velocity state and initialize its object stack. Preserve script cursor Y.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadObjectTypeDescriptors
commentary_units.summary: Use twice the type index to load collision and rendering descriptor pointers from $AB39/$AB7F. Clear state except facing bits and install a default helper pointer.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptBroadcastResponse
commentary_units.summary: Apply an operand response to every other active object and set its linked-source slot bits, then continue the issuing object's script.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TryObjectResponse
commentary_units.summary: Accept response when operand priority is at least the current low-three-bit state and the type-specific response table entry is not $FF. Install a pending action, raise the state to priority+1 and return carry set.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TryHigherPriorityResponse
commentary_units.summary: Like the related response helper, but requires strictly greater priority and selects the second half of the type-specific 32-byte table. Carry reports whether a response was installed.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptBranchOnNativeCarry
commentary_units.summary: Call a native helper pointer; carry set selects the following script target, otherwise skip that target and continue.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptRandomThresholdBranch
commentary_units.summary: Generate a byte and compare with the operand threshold. Values below it select the following target; other values skip it.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptObjectRandomBranch
commentary_units.summary: Use the object-specific threshold at $0641 with the same branch/skip convention.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptBranchOnUnchangedPlayerInput
commentary_units.summary: For player type zero, compare masked held controls with PreviousActionControls: equality jumps to the script target and a change skips it. Other types advance the pseudo-random state, compare the returned byte with $50, and jump to the target only when carry is set; otherwise skip it.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScriptRequestSound
commentary_units.summary: Read a sound ID and submit it when player health/count allows, or unconditionally for ID6. Restore interpreter slot/cursor afterward.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: RequestPrioritizedSound
commentary_units.summary: Compare the sound priority table value with current priority $06BE. Equal/higher priority wins and writes request ID with bit7 to the sound engine. Preserve Y.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: MoveObjectRelativeToFacing
commentary_units.summary: Combine operand sign with object orientation, then add or subtract its seven-bit magnitude from the 16-bit horizontal position.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: MoveObjectVertically
commentary_units.summary: Convert the encoded operand around $80 to the signed delta convention and add it to the object vertical coordinate.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadObjectGraphicsTriplet
commentary_units.summary: Use A*3 to select a three-byte record at CPU $852E and write it into the object-specific four-byte RAM slot at $77+X*4+1. Preserve caller X/Y; the remaining slot byte has a separate consumer.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: WriteMMC1Control
commentary_units.summary: Serialize the low five bits of A, least significant first, to $9FFF (MMC1 control register). This takes five writes; the resulting mapper configuration is distinct from effective PRG bank identity.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: SelectMMC1PRGRegister
commentary_units.summary: Serialize A bits0..4 to $FFFF (MMC1 PRG register). Main code uses value6 for banks12/13 and value0 for banks0/1; effective slot identities remain the authority.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ResetEntry
commentary_units.summary: Disable interrupts/decimal mode, initialize stack, wait two vblanks, disable PPU and clear all 2KiB RAM. Reset MMC1 serial state, configure its control register and select main PRG bank6 before boot screens.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ClearInternalRAM
commentary_units.summary: Clear all eight internal-RAM pages in one 256-iteration loop. The zero-page indexed write is deliberately zero-page encoded.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeMapperAndGame
commentary_units.summary: Reset MMC1 using high-bit read/modify/write accesses, set control $0E and PRG6, initialize score records and random seed, then show boot/title/menu screens.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ShowTitleAndModeSelection
commentary_units.summary: Load initial graphics state, detect the conditional four-direction input mode flag, show title selector0 and run mode selection. Restore selected stage and player progression bytes before stage initialization.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeNewStage
commentary_units.summary: Reset score/lives/timer/gameplay flags and copy the zero-based stage $22 into active-stage $A1. Initialize stage stream and run the demonstration/practice scene with special state enabled. This entry is the validated artificial-progression contract.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: PrepareStageGameplay
commentary_units.summary: Clear pause and camera state, initialize scrolling streams/resources and copy the stage palette. Build HUD/background, initialize player/objects and enable frame-driven rendering.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeStageObjectsAndDisplay
commentary_units.summary: Reload stage stream, initialize player slot, clear transient RAM, enable PPU interrupts/display, then wait for a frame before the stage intro.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: RunStageIntroDelay
commentary_units.summary: Set special state while running a 180-frame intro helper, update the lives display, restore normal state and request stage-specific music.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: GameplayFrameLoop
commentary_units.summary: Set the frame request latch, derive a coarse progress byte from the scrolling reference, poll input and pause state, then update objects/stage/background when running. Draw sprites, perform timed PPU work, update HUD/audio and test death or stage-clear flags.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: WaitForSpriteZeroSplit
commentary_units.summary: Poll PPUSTATUS bit6 before timed palette/scroll work. The first sprite is initialized as a split marker; this dependency is why artificial jumps require an initialized display.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CameraSignedOffsetLookupStart
commentary_units.summary: First cell of the sixteen signed camera offsets, continued immediately below. This byte was formerly Static Code, never Observed. AND01 followed by STA and BPL makes the apparent fallthrough impossible; the offset consumer establishes the data role.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: ApplyNegativeCameraOffset
commentary_units.summary: Add a negative lookup offset to the camera low byte and adjust the high nametable bit through carry. The positive path above uses a separate high-byte update.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdateGameplayPresentation
commentary_units.summary: Service incremental graphics loading, derive scroll speed from player position, update progress/status markers and HUD, then service sound on three of every four iterations.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CheckPlayerDeath
commentary_units.summary: Player type zero continues play; another type decrements lives, optionally shows the score screen, and calls SwapActivePlayerRecords before the classified ChoosePostStagePlayer continuation.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TestStageClearFlag
commentary_units.summary: Continue ordinary frames until $B1 equals1. At clear, wait for the frame latch and call the bonus-to-score conversion routine at D902.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DispatchPostStageScreen
commentary_units.summary: Index $D27B by zero-based stage. Nonnegative screen IDs are presented before incrementing stage. Stage15 selects ending screen3; natural clear and scoring remain unproved by the artificial entry experiment.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdvanceStageNumber
commentary_units.summary: Increment stage, treating fifteen as the end of the stage sequence. Otherwise save the next stage in the selected player progression byte, then return through the classified stage restart continuation.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TimedPaletteAndHUDSplit
commentary_units.summary: Disable rendering, write selected palette triples with deliberate cycle delays and PPUDATA reads, reset PPU addressing/scroll, then restore modified PPU control/mask shadows. Preserve timing filler instructions and read side effects.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeGameplayNametables
commentary_units.summary: Clear both nametables, build mirrored attribute patterns and HUD tile blocks, draw player-specific indicators, then fill the upper rows with tile $28.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ClearFirstNametable
commentary_units.summary: Set PPU address $2000 and clear 1024 bytes through the shared fill loop.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ClearSecondNametable
commentary_units.summary: Set PPU address $2400 and clear 1024 bytes through the shared fill loop.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: FillNametableWithZero
commentary_units.summary: Four pages of 256 PPUDATA writes fill the selected nametable including attributes.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdateHUDSchedule
commentary_units.summary: Advance the gameplay timer when active, then dispatch one of four HUD update helpers using a modulo-four scheduling byte. The table includes a no-op slot.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: HUDNoUpdate
commentary_units.summary: Return for the scheduler slot that has no queued HUD change.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueOpponentHealth
commentary_units.summary: Retain a selected opponent while valid, otherwise search slots1..3 for one with a nonzero display count. After losing a target, delay briefly before switching/blanking its bar.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueuePlayerHealth
commentary_units.summary: Clear the player health dirty byte and select player slot0, then queue the common ten-cell health display.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueHealthBarCells
commentary_units.summary: Append a ten-byte HUD write record to RAM page2. Choose player/opponent destination, then encode filled/empty cells from health and the selected target's display count. Advance producer cursor $6D.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueScoreIfDirty
commentary_units.summary: When score dirty $9C is set, append a six-digit score record to the HUD queue and clear dirty. Suppress leading zero tiles, always showing the final digit.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TickGameplayClock
commentary_units.summary: Count a subsecond divider and three decimal timer digits. On zero time, periodically reduce player health and request sound $10. Otherwise queue the timer digits, suppressing/blinking leading fields near timeout.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueLivesDisplay
commentary_units.summary: Append five lives-indicator cells at a player-dependent HUD address, filling cells below the current lives count. Queue records share producer cursor $6D.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializePlayerObject
commentary_units.summary: Deactivate objects and initialize slot0: type0, frame $20, health10, fixed script/bounds/render descriptors, graphics flags and reference-relative position. Reset target selection and player script counters; this is required before entering active gameplay.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ReadController
commentary_units.summary: Strobe controller1, then read eight serial bits from the selected controller port into $25. High bits become A/B, then SELECT/START, then directions. Outside special menu/multiplayer cases, retain A/B only after three matching historical samples.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: FilterActionButtons
commentary_units.summary: Shift three action-button history samples and compare mask $C0. If they are not identical, clear A/B while preserving SELECT/START/directions. This filters held action input rather than direction input.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeStageStreamAndReference
commentary_units.summary: Use four-byte stage headers at CPU $8000 to derive the initial scrolling reference; use the stage pointer table at $803C for $16/$17. Clear stage-clear $B1 and compute stage*3 for action selection. Effective bank12 must occupy $8000.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: RunStageIntroFrames
commentary_units.summary: Run 180 frames of HUD/background/sprite updates while holding a fixed speed selector, synchronizing the PPU split and frame latch each iteration. Preserve the counter on the CPU stack.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdatePauseState
commentary_units.summary: Use START presses/releases to cycle $05 through four states: zero and2 accept a press;1 and3 wait for release. Return the state so nonzero states suppress normal gameplay updates.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ResetGraphicsLoadState
commentary_units.summary: Clear object/player graphics loader flags and shared-slot reference counts.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ScheduleObjectGraphics
commentary_units.summary: Choose a shared graphics slot/reference count for this object, load its type-dependent bank/source/count metadata and mark the object unready until incremental loading finishes. The negative-type special path retains its slot-release and absent-reference behavior.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CopyObjectGraphicsChunk
commentary_units.summary: When an object load is pending and the previous chunk is consumed, map its resource bank and copy32 bytes to $0580. Restore PRG6 and raise a ready flag. At zero remaining chunks, mark the object ready and clear load flags.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: PreparePlayerGraphicsChunks
commentary_units.summary: When player frame changes and no outstanding chunk blocks it, resolve its graphics descriptor, then process up to three three-byte records. Copy each referenced32-byte bank0 block into RAM and build staging metadata. $FF ends the descriptor; swapping waits for the consumer flag.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CopyPlayerGraphicsRecord
commentary_units.summary: Map PRG3 to read a three-byte descriptor; its first two bytes encode a bank0 source and the third is retained as metadata. Copy32 bytes into the current staging destination and advance source/destination cursors.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CommitPlayerGraphicsMetadata
commentary_units.summary: Wait for prior graphics data consumption, copy three-byte records from $0520 to $0548 through the $FF sentinel, clear loader state and toggle the player graphics destination bank bit.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadStageResource
commentary_units.summary: Use stage index X to select the resource ID at $DCBC and tail through the common decompressed transfer loader.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadCommonResource
commentary_units.summary: Load resource selector $15 through the common transfer path.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ServiceBankedSound
commentary_units.summary: Map PRG0 for the sound engine at $89D0, then restore PRG6. This wrapper preserves the main code view only after its final mapper write.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadPalette
commentary_units.summary: A indexes separate low/high palette-pointer arrays. Write the same16-byte palette twice to fill32 PPU bytes, caching the first16 at $0570, then reset PPU palette address.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadCompressedPPUResource
commentary_units.summary: Resolve an eight-byte descriptor, disable PPU display, map the resource bank, decode bytes into PPUDATA for the descriptor count, then restore PPU shadows and PRG6. Resource data remains separate from code classification.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DecodeResourceByte
commentary_units.summary: Return a pending repeated or literal byte. Nonnegative headers encode literal length header+1; negative headers encode a repeated following byte, returned immediately with complemented-header additional repeats. Advance a page-spanning source pointer/cursor.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: LoadResourceDescriptor
commentary_units.summary: A selects a little-endian descriptor pointer through $DDEC. Copy eight fields to $CB..$D2: an unused/control byte, bank selector, two output counters, source pointer, and PPU destination. Exact resource roles differ by selector.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: InitializeScrollingStreams
commentary_units.summary: Reset scroll counters/speed flags and nametable addresses. Stage/section indices select two background-column streams and a control stream. Construct pointers at $C0..$C5; the two column-ID streams each hold five64-byte groups and the control stream holds five16-byte groups.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UpdateScrollingBackground
commentary_units.summary: Map PRG1, interpret background control markers ($FE stops scrolling; $FF sets a halt flag), and accumulate scroll speed. Move the world reference four units per pixel; every32 pixels queue a new column. Restore PRG6 before returning.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueBackgroundColumn
commentary_units.summary: Choose two column definitions from stage-specific pointer tables. Queue four vertical-increment tile records containing12+6 bytes each, followed by five attribute writes assembled from both definitions. Advance stream cursors and alternate nametable destinations at the boundary.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueueBackgroundTileSlice
commentary_units.summary: Append a high-bit count $92, PPU address and18 bytes to the page2 queue. Four slices form the new column; advance source pointers by12/6 after each slice.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: MergeBackgroundAttributes
commentary_units.summary: Collect three attribute bytes from one column and two from the other, force upper bits of the final scratch byte to $A0, then queue five one-byte writes eight attribute cells apart.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdvanceBackgroundColumnStreams
commentary_units.summary: Advance both column streams; wrap the tile destination at $A0 and toggle nametable bit2 for tile/attribute high addresses. Decrement the current control-run count.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: BuildObjectSprites
commentary_units.summary: Count sprite demand by four allocation groups, adjust per-group rotation state, clear OAM except the split marker, then emit each active object. Restore PRG6 after banked frame-descriptor access. The allocation scheme limits each group and rotates overflow to reduce persistent dropout.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AdjustSpriteAllocationRotation
commentary_units.summary: For groups needing at least nine sprites, compare rotation position with total/player demand before retaining or resetting it. This balances the later front/back allocation partitions.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ClearDynamicOAM
commentary_units.summary: Hide OAM bytes4..255 with $FF, preserving the first four-byte split-marker sprite.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: RenderObjectSprites
commentary_units.summary: Player uses staged frame metadata at $0548; other types resolve their banked frame list. Convert world x to screen pixels, cull outlying objects, orient coordinates, add vertical origin and choose the graphics tile base.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ReadObjectSpriteRecord
commentary_units.summary: A negative first byte ends the sprite list. Each three-byte record provides allocation group/vertical offset, tile offset and horizontal offset; actual tile index is twice the encoded offset plus the graphics base.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: AllocateObjectSpriteSlot
commentary_units.summary: Choose a slot from one of four sixteen-sprite partitions, with two subranges of eight/seven entries. Count demand and use the current rotation threshold to choose which partition half receives this record.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: WriteObjectSpriteRecord
commentary_units.summary: Scale allocated slot to its four-byte OAM offset. Subtract vertical offset, select priority relative to stage threshold, add the object tile base, then apply mirrored/unmirrored horizontal offset. Hide sprites whose x arithmetic lies offscreen.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CountFrameSpriteDemand
commentary_units.summary: Resolve the frame descriptor and count each three-byte sprite record into its allocation group until $FF. These demand counts drive sprite allocation rotation.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ResolveObjectFrameSprites
commentary_units.summary: Map PRG3, load the object rendering-descriptor pointer and select a little-endian frame-list pointer by current frame*2. Return that pointer in $2A/$2B; PRG6 restoration belongs to the outer caller.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: TransmitControllerPortSequence
commentary_units.summary: X selects a bank3 sequence. Drive JOYPAD1 high, delay, then serialize the first byte and the following count-controlled bytes through controller output. Return the port low and restore PRG6. The intended external peripheral/effect is unknown; do not infer full accessory support.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: SerializeControllerPortByte
commentary_units.summary: Transmit eight bits most significant first through JOYPAD1 writes, interleaved with reads and a delay. This is output signaling, separate from normal button polling.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: NormalizeObjectOrientationBits
commentary_units.summary: Replace flag bit7 with the prior bit6 while retaining lower bits. This reconciles the two orientation bits; exact action-specific reason remains uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: QueuePracticeMoveCaption
commentary_units.summary: Only special state $AE=1 draws this caption. Select a pointer from action selector-$10, append16 encoded glyph tiles to a HUD queue record at PPU $2168, translating one special value to blank.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ReturnFixedVerticalValue
commentary_units.summary: Return constant100 in A. Its native-script calling role is supported, but game-specific meaning beyond the repeated vertical baseline is uncertain.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: IncrementNonwrappingCounter
commentary_units.summary: Increment RAM $AB unless it would wrap from $FF to0. The counter therefore saturates at255; its gameplay role is unresolved.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: NMIEntry
commentary_units.summary: Save A/X/Y in dedicated RAM, decrement a delay counter, DMA OAM page3 and clear the frame-request latch. Upload palette state, run one scheduled VRAM task, restore scroll/control/mask and registers, then return from interrupt.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UploadFramePalette
commentary_units.summary: Write background palette from $0570 and sprite palettes from per-object RAM triplets, forcing shared separator entries to color4. This is explicit unrolled work within the vblank budget.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DispatchVblankTask
commentary_units.summary: Rotate through four task pointers at $FF0B, then invoke the indirect trampoline. Restore the horizontal scroll plus nametable bit and software PPU mask afterward.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UploadObjectGraphicsChunk
commentary_units.summary: If $9A=1, upload exactly32 staged bytes from $0580 to the object graphics destination, advance that destination by32 and clear the ready flag. The writes are unrolled for fixed vblank timing.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: VblankTaskPhase0
commentary_units.summary: Attempt a player graphics chunk and an object graphics chunk, then reset PPUADDR. Three scheduled wrappers share this structure; the fourth focuses on queue draining.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: VblankTaskPhase1
commentary_units.summary: Run the same staged graphics transfers as phase0 and reset PPUADDR.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: VblankTaskPhase2
commentary_units.summary: Run the same staged graphics transfers as phase0 and reset PPUADDR.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: DrainVRAMWriteQueue
commentary_units.summary: Upload a ready object chunk, then consume page2 records between cursors $6E and $6D, bounded by record budget $6F. Record header low7 bits is payload length; bit7 enables PPU increment32 instead of1. Next bytes give big-endian PPU address and literal payload. Save consumer cursor.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ReadVRAMWriteRecord
commentary_units.summary: Stop when producer and consumer agree. Otherwise read count/stride, set PPUCTRL and PPUADDR, write the record payload and decrement this interrupt's record budget.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: ResetPPUAddressAfterTask
commentary_units.summary: Reset the PPU address latch after a vblank task. The NMI epilogue later restores scroll/control state.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: UploadPlayerGraphicsChunk
commentary_units.summary: If $9B is ready, clear it and upload96 bytes from $04A0 through $04FF to the player graphics destination. Advance destination by96. Without a ready player chunk, fall through the queue-draining path instead; wrappers may therefore run queue work here.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: CallVblankTaskPointer
commentary_units.summary: Indirect trampoline through $4C/$4D; task RTS returns to the NMI dispatcher.
commentary_units.context_note: Fixed PRG slot

commentary_units.name: SoundRepeatResume
commentary_units.summary: Restore this voice's saved sequence cursor and resume command dispatch.

commentary_units.name: SoundRepeatSave
commentary_units.summary: Save the repeat count from the stream, retaining the advanced cursor for sequence dispatch.

commentary_units.name: SoundSkipRepeatOperands
commentary_units.summary: Skip the three repeat operands and resume the sequence after the completed repetition.

commentary_units.name: EnterScoreName
commentary_units.summary: Build a sprite keyboard cursor and six character slots. A selects the highlighted glyph, the delete glyph backs up one position, and the finish glyph exits. Direction lookup deltas move the cursor only inside the keyboard bounds; direct OAM DMA animates each step while waiting for controller release. The accepted characters are also written to the score-name buffer.

commentary_units.name: FinishScoreRecordClear
commentary_units.summary: Finish clearing the record slots and clear the score-screen state before returning.

commentary_units.name: FinishScoreRowSprites
commentary_units.summary: Fill the remaining score-row sprite tiles, move backward by the row stride, and continue until every row is prepared.

commentary_units.name: CompareObjectViewportDistance
commentary_units.summary: Compare adjusted object X against the camera origin as a sixteen-bit difference. Carry reports the bounded interval selected by each entry; the second entry compares the stored position directly. These predicates retain their signed-wrap behavior.

commentary_units.name: ComparePlayerFacingDistance
commentary_units.summary: Compare player and current-object X as a sixteen-bit difference, then select the facing-bit comparison appropriate to the side. Return carry to the script predicate caller.

commentary_units.name: TestPlayerHealthAndFacingWindow
commentary_units.summary: Reject the special zero-health case, then compare adjusted object position with the camera origin. Orientation selects the wrapped high-byte interval; carry is the predicate result.

commentary_units.name: CopyLinkedObjectFacing
commentary_units.summary: Retain the current object's low six flags and copy the high two orientation flags from the object selected by linkage bits three and four.

commentary_units.name: TestHeightAndUpdateDecimalTimer
commentary_units.summary: The first entry compares height against seven. The following entry increments a capped decimal timer when player health is at least ten; otherwise it restores health and the cached HUD value to ten.

commentary_units.name: StartCameraOffsetSequence
commentary_units.summary: Start the sixteen-cell camera-offset sequence at index fifteen; the update consumer decrements toward zero.

commentary_units.name: ReleaseObjectAndMarkUnused
commentary_units.summary: Release the object's counted graphics/resource slot, then mark its type unused with FF.

commentary_units.name: FinishObjectXCarry
commentary_units.summary: Propagate the low-byte X addition carry into the stored high byte before the surrounding movement path continues.

commentary_units.name: ScriptCounterPredicates
commentary_units.summary: Six ordinary entries compare the corresponding counter with zero; six following entries decrement it. The shared modulo-six selector advances B6 and returns wrapped A. Subsequent predicates compare that phase against five through one, test three object slots, or test the OR of all six counters. Exact game-event meanings remain unresolved.

commentary_units.name: SetObjectPaletteTriplet
commentary_units.summary: Select the object's four-byte palette slot and set its first three values to 0F,20,20.

commentary_units.name: SetObjectPaletteMiddle
commentary_units.summary: Set the middle color of the object's palette slot to 10.

commentary_units.name: SetObjectPaletteAccent
commentary_units.summary: Set the middle and final colors of the object's palette slot to 28 and10.

commentary_units.name: IncrementTypeCounter
commentary_units.summary: Map the object type to one of six counters; negative entries skip counting. Request sound11 after the accepted increment.

commentary_units.name: QueueDecimalGlyphPair
commentary_units.summary: Append two two-byte PPU writes to the VRAM queue. The second address is one nametable row below the first; a four-byte table record supplies the two glyph pairs. Store the advanced queue cursor.

commentary_units.name: RunScorePresentation
commentary_units.summary: Return immediately when all six counters are zero. Otherwise disable rendering, build the presentation object and resources, then run frame tasks until the object slots and counters finish. Refresh decimal score glyphs only when dirty and retain frame synchronization and sound bank restoration.

commentary_units.name: DrawEncodedInstructionText
commentary_units.summary: Select an encoded text pointer and PPU destination from the current index. Zero advances to the next nametable row, one ends the text, and a space performs a PPU read to advance the destination. Other bytes map through the glyph alphabet; the conversion returns alphabet index plus E3.

commentary_units.name: SelectMenuTextDestination
commentary_units.summary: Load the alternate menu PPU destination and selector before joining the common text path.

commentary_units.name: ReturnToMenuSelection
commentary_units.summary: Rejoin the common menu-selection update after the local condition.

commentary_units.name: RunControllerOutputMenu
commentary_units.summary: Prepare the two text areas, run the menu selector, adjust the selection for the second player, and dispatch a counted output sequence only for the supported option and mode. The external peripheral meaning is unresolved.

commentary_units.name: SkipOptionalScreenSetup
commentary_units.summary: Join the common screen setup continuation without executing the optional branch.

commentary_units.name: FinishSixCharacterSprites
commentary_units.summary: Build each character sprite at a ten-pixel horizontal stride with zero attributes, stopping after six slots.

commentary_units.name: SkipUnavailableObject
commentary_units.summary: Use the allocator's carry result to skip the unavailable object slot.

commentary_units.name: InitializeObjectActionScript
commentary_units.summary: Compute type times32 plus the response-record base. The first response chooses the action script, copied into current and saved script pointers. Reset frame sentinels and script stack state before the ordinary object update.

commentary_units.name: ResumeConfiguredFailureScript
commentary_units.summary: When the native predicate fails, clear its enabled bit and install the configured failure script as current and saved pointers. Reset frame/stack state; the indirect entry dispatches through the prepared native pointer.

commentary_units.name: FinishSavedActionPointer
commentary_units.summary: Store the action pointer's high byte in the saved continuation before the surrounding command resumes.

commentary_units.name: StageWaitForEmptySlots
commentary_units.summary: Wait while any of object slots three through one is occupied; once all contain FF, advance the stage stream.

commentary_units.name: StageSpawnSideChoice
commentary_units.summary: Use the high bit of the stage operand to select the spawn side while retaining the preceding coordinate comparison.

commentary_units.name: FinishStageSpawnPosition
commentary_units.summary: Propagate the X subtraction borrow into the high byte and set the spawned object's orientation flags.

commentary_units.name: StageSoundScrollAndWaitCommands
commentary_units.summary: Handlers request a sound, disable/enable scrolling, mark all three slots, or mark only slots matching the operand type.
