The stage-end command sets B1 only while player health is nonzero. The timed-wait command initializes B2 once, decrements each frame, then consumes its operand and advances.

commentary_units.name: StageSetObjectGate
commentary_units.summary: Set the fixed object-state gate and advance the stage command stream.

commentary_units.name: PositionObjectInPageOne
commentary_units.summary: Complete the selected spawn coordinate with camera high byte plus one, apply the facing-dependent offset, and return carry set.

commentary_units.name: PositionObjectInPageTwo
commentary_units.summary: Complete the selected spawn coordinate with camera high byte plus two, apply the facing-dependent offset, and return carry set.

commentary_units.name: PositionObjectInCameraPage
commentary_units.summary: Complete the coordinate in the camera page, apply the facing-dependent offset, and return carry set.

commentary_units.name: PositionObjectInPageThree
commentary_units.summary: Complete the coordinate with camera high byte plus three, apply the facing-dependent offset, and return carry set.

commentary_units.name: ApplyFacingXOffset
commentary_units.summary: Apply the unsigned displacement in scratch34 to the sixteen-bit object X. The orientation sign selects subtraction versus addition; preserve carry/borrow into the high byte.

commentary_units.name: ScriptUpdateOrientationBit
commentary_units.summary: Use the helper result to clear or set orientation bit40. Only a changed state requests sound0B; all paths resume the VM command cursor.

commentary_units.name: RemoveObjectAndUnlink
commentary_units.summary: Mark the object unused and release its counted slot. Clear linkage bits on every object referring to the removed slot, restoring the caller's object index before return.

commentary_units.name: ScriptAddPackedDecimalScore
commentary_units.summary: Read a two-byte score operand, pass its low/high packed decimal digits to the score adder, restore the object index, and advance the script.

commentary_units.name: ScriptConfigureNativeAndFailure
commentary_units.summary: Read four bytes into the native-pointer and failure-script fields. Adjacent handlers enable/disable the native pointer through its high bit or save the current stream continuation. The four-byte configuration distinguishes this command from an ordinary two-byte call.

commentary_units.name: ScriptHeightThresholdContinuation
commentary_units.summary: Compare against height50 and return to the existing height-limit branch with its carry result.

commentary_units.name: ScriptSaveAndCompareLinkedContinuation
commentary_units.summary: Save the current script pointer. The following entry resolves the linked object and compares saved continuation pointers, branching through the VM transfer helper on equality and skipping the two-byte destination otherwise. The final entry extracts linkage bits into X.

commentary_units.name: ScriptAlignToLinkedObject
commentary_units.summary: Resolve the property displacement and linked object. Apply signed movement times four to linked X, then apply the property displacement according to current orientation. Clear movement and wait state, restore Y, and resume command dispatch.

commentary_units.name: AddPackedDecimalScore
commentary_units.summary: Ignore additions while score updates are inhibited. Add four packed operand digits into the six unpacked decimal score cells, explicitly propagating decimal carries. Crossing the upper four-digit boundary awards a life up to the configured cap and requests sound; mark the HUD dirty after updating.

commentary_units.name: RefreshPlayerHUDAndState
commentary_units.summary: Mark the HUD dirty and refresh health/lives plus the active-player state before continuing stage setup.

commentary_units.name: ChoosePostStagePlayer
commentary_units.summary: Continue the active player when lives remain; otherwise select the alternate-player state if present and rejoin the stage loop.

commentary_units.name: BeginPostStagePresentation
commentary_units.summary: Disable rendering, retain the VRAM queue endpoint, run the score presentation, and request the post-stage sound through the bank-restoring engine wrapper.

commentary_units.name: ResumeStageAfterPresentation
commentary_units.summary: Return to the common stage restart path.

commentary_units.name: MarkHealthHUDChanged
commentary_units.summary: Increment the cached health value so the surrounding comparison schedules the necessary HUD refresh.

commentary_units.name: ConvertStageBonusToScore
commentary_units.summary: Remove opponent slots and prepare the bonus loop. Each synchronized iteration services sound, graphics, objects and split rendering. Drain decimal time first, awarding100 per step; then drain health at the same score rate. Install the EE40 player script when health reaches zero and wait for its object movement to finish before clearing the phase state.

commentary_units.name: SwapActivePlayerRecords
commentary_units.summary: Only in the two-player continuation mode, exchange lives, selection and six score digits with the alternate record, then toggle the active-player bit.

commentary_units.name: ClearObjectCountedSlot
commentary_units.summary: Mark the object's counted-slot reference absent with FF.

commentary_units.name: ReleaseCountedSlot
commentary_units.summary: If the object has a nonnegative counted-slot index, decrement that slot's reference count. A negative index leaves counts unchanged.

commentary_units.name: RendererSkipTriple
commentary_units.summary: Advance Y over the three-byte render record and rejoin the sprite iteration using the inherited carry. Effective PRG view is [6,7,14,15].

commentary_units.name: LinkedPlayerFrameAndPosition
commentary_units.summary: The first predicate tests player type/state. The following helper chooses a frame offset from player state, copies adjusted player X minus14, subtracts a further28 for the opposite facing, and clears the current orientation sign bit. These native entries use ordinary balanced returns.

commentary_units.name: ClearPlayerOrientationFlags
commentary_units.summary: Clear the player's upper two orientation flags while retaining the lower six state bits. The EE40 frame/native loop calls this helper; a static writer at C42E/C433 installs the preceding EE3A script.

commentary_units.name: TestControllerHighBits
commentary_units.summary: Ordinary predicate entries return selected controller high bits through carry. The chained entry conditionally inverts bit80 before testing; another tests the opposite state of bit40. Specific move names and natural selection remain unresolved.

commentary_units.name: CompareObjectTypeOne
commentary_units.summary: Three entries compare type against one in opposite operand orders or return carry clear unconditionally. Carry is the native predicate result; callers determine its game meaning.

commentary_units.name: TestSelectedObjectTypeTwo
commentary_units.summary: Test the selected object's type against two; a failed equality path returns carry clear.

commentary_units.name: SaveAndCompareControllerState
commentary_units.summary: Save the current controller state in scratch59. The following entry compares the saved/current bytes and returns carry clear on a change; equality retains comparison carry.

commentary_units.name: PlayerStateAndFramePredicates
commentary_units.summary: Predicate entries distinguish player states1A/1B, advance the current frame up to three times while below64, or compare current and player saved continuation pointers. Each returns carry as the script decision.

commentary_units.name: InstallPlayerScriptF6B6
commentary_units.summary: Write the player's current script pointer to F6B6; this static writer establishes the following script root without proving natural selection.

commentary_units.name: SelectAndPositionLinkedTarget
commentary_units.summary: One entry clears the linked target's health and the selection gate. The selector accepts only a distinct active selected object with the required flag, stores its slot, and returns carry clear on success. The positioning entry uses adjusted target X plus bounded random displacement and target height plus20 minus a six-bit random value; invalid targets return carry set.

commentary_units.name: TestObjectHealthEmpty
commentary_units.summary: Return carry set only when the current object health is below one.

commentary_units.name: TestPlayerStateAndRequestSound
commentary_units.summary: Test state five through carry. Separate entries release object slot one while restoring the current index, or set the fixed state latch and submit sound request one through the bank-restoring sound wrapper.

commentary_units.name: ComparePlayerTypeOne
commentary_units.summary: Compare player type against one with carry semantics from one minus type; this is an ordinary native predicate, not a new VM record.

commentary_units.name: SoundInstrumentRecords
commentary_units.summary: Thirty eight-byte instrument records. The voice setup consumers use the first six fields; the next rooted sequence independently bounds the array. The remaining repeated records have the same layout, although their natural selection is unproved.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundSequencePrograms
commentary_units.summary: Voice sequence programs selected by four parallel directories. Commands are stop0, pattern1, absolute cursor jump2 and repeat3; operands and cursor advancement follow the sound interpreter. Roots and complete parsed successors bound this entire container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundPatternRelativeOffsets
commentary_units.summary: Thirty-one selected relative-offset arrays. A pattern ID indexes a little-endian displacement added to the selection's pattern base; these are not absolute CPU pointers.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundPatternEvents
commentary_units.summary: Pattern event streams: literal note/duration pairs, instrument changes and FF termination. Parsed note values are0..12 and instrument values0..26. All pointers and consumers require the sound bank0 view.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundPatternFFSuffix
commentary_units.summary: Twenty-one FF bytes between the parsed final sound event and the sound entry. Repetition and neighboring boundaries support generic data; their original purpose is unknown.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundSelectionDirectories
commentary_units.summary: Four arrays of31 little-endian sequence pointers, followed by31 offset-array pointers and31 pattern bases. Trailing voice-table origins select each channel. The sound selector and pattern consumers establish the strides; directory entries do not prove every song was played.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: SoundDurationMasksAndTimers
commentary_units.summary: Sound duration values, channel masks and note-period lookup cells used by the voice writer. The16 duration cells and note domain are consumer bounded. Boundary cells remain generic lookup data with unresolved individual meanings.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: PlayerSpriteBitplanes
commentary_units.summary: NES two-bitplane body-part graphics copied in32-byte chunks by the player graphics copier. Rooted frames select the earlier portion; visual bitplane coherence supports the remaining tail without claiming it is selected.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: ObjectRawSpriteGraphicsBank1
commentary_units.summary: Raw object sprite source copied in32-byte chunks. Object graphics metadata bounds the selected source union in mapper bank1, effective PRG[2,3,14,15]. These bytes are graphics source, not CPU instructions.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: BackgroundGroup3Columns
commentary_units.summary: Selected mapper-bank1 background column directory and records. Little-endian directory pointers end at the first record. Primary columns occupy51 bytes and secondary columns26 bytes; tile copy and attribute consumers establish those strides. The next group independently bounds this container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: BackgroundGroup0Columns
commentary_units.summary: Selected mapper-bank1 background column directory and records. Little-endian directory pointers end at the first record. Primary columns occupy51 bytes and secondary columns26 bytes; tile copy and attribute consumers establish those strides. The next group independently bounds this container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: BackgroundGroup2Columns
commentary_units.summary: Selected mapper-bank1 background column directory and records. Little-endian directory pointers end at the first record. Primary columns occupy51 bytes and secondary columns26 bytes; tile copy and attribute consumers establish those strides. The next group independently bounds this container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: BackgroundGroup4Columns
commentary_units.summary: Selected mapper-bank1 background column directory and records. Little-endian directory pointers end at the first record. Primary columns occupy51 bytes and secondary columns26 bytes; tile copy and attribute consumers establish those strides. The next group independently bounds this container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: BackgroundGroup1Columns
commentary_units.summary: Selected mapper-bank1 background column directory and records. Little-endian directory pointers end at the first record. Primary columns occupy51 bytes and secondary columns26 bytes; tile copy and attribute consumers establish those strides. The next group independently bounds this container.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: Bank2MixedGraphicsSources
commentary_units.summary: Mixed raw and encoded graphics source in this selected mapper bank. The32-byte raw copier and descriptor RLE consumers jointly cover the window; primary bitplane/format review found no native-code conflict. In mapper bank2 a52-byte interior gap consists of26 identical8000 pairs. Exact original subasset boundaries and the purpose of unselected repeated cells remain unresolved. Never continue a selected-window source past CPU C000 as contiguous physical bank storage.
commentary_units.context_note: Data physical identity; CPU pointer interpretation requires its consumer-selected PRG view.

commentary_units.name: Bank3SpriteFrameDirectoriesAndRecords
commentary_units.summary: Twenty frame directories select FF-terminated lists of three-byte sprite-part records. The renderer combines position offsets and a part/tile selector with object position and facing. Pointer lists, record endings and the next resource independently bound the container; different object types may share frames.
